title: transmute — hideous

sentences.sentence: Ascension long ago served to transmute karma of the consensus known as Earth so that Earth could retain her vibration.
sentences.translation: 很久之前，提升就为改变地球这个一致实相的业力而服务，好让地球可留在其振动中。

sentences.sentence: That luxury appears to be fading as power consumption has skyrocketed and the circuit boards on which the microprocessors sit threaten to transmute themselves into space heaters.
sentences.translation: 但随著耗电量急遽高升，微处理器所在的电路板恐有变身为暖炉的危险，电脑产业既有的优势似乎正渐渐消逝。

sentences.sentence: When performing taint flow analysis, the scanner models the flow of data within the system.
sentences.translation: 当执行污染流分析时，检测器会在这个系统中为数据流建立模型。

sentences.sentence: His fingers were badly lacerated by the broken glass.
sentences.translation: 他的手指被碎玻璃严重割伤。

sentences.sentence: A large detachment of police was used to segregate the two rival camps of protesters.
sentences.translation: 一大队分遣警察被派来隔离两群敌对的抗议者。

sentences.sentence: In the early 1990’s an extreme form of isolation emerged, where young Japanese people seclude themselves in their homes for months or even years at a time.
sentences.translation: 早在20世纪90年代初的时候，日本出现了一种极端的孤独症状，患有此症状的日本青年人一度成年累月地把自己隔离在家中。

sentences.sentence: an attempt to eradicate inflation
sentences.translation: 为消除通货膨胀所作的努力

sentences.sentence: This problem has now been completely eradicated.
sentences.translation: 这个问题现已彻底杜绝。

sentences.sentence: The company has consolidated its position as the country’s leading gas supplier.
sentences.translation: 这家公司巩固了作为该国主要煤气供应商的地位。

sentences.sentence: The team consolidated their lead with a third goal.
sentences.translation: 球队以第三个进球巩固了领先优势。

translations.translation: 共谋, 阴谋, (指事件)凑合起来

sentences.sentence: They'd conspired to overthrow the government.
sentences.translation: 他们曾合谋推翻政府。

sentences.sentence: DJ Dominic purveys a unique brand of music.
sentences.translation: 音乐节目主持人多米尼克播放一种独特的音乐。

sentences.sentence: Alexander has been preaching patience.
sentences.translation: 亚历山大一直宣扬要坚忍。

sentences.sentence: He accused union leaders of instigating the disturbances.
sentences.translation: 他指责工会领导人煽动骚乱。

sentences.sentence: Carey’s hope was that the church would be renewed and invigorated.
sentences.translation: 凯里希望教会能复兴。

sentences.sentence: People were indoctrinated not to question their leaders.
sentences.translation: 人们被灌输对领导人不得置疑的观念。

phrases.translation: 人工耳蜗；耳蜗植入；耳郭灌输治疗

sentences.sentence: The diagram implanted a dangerous prejudice firmly in the minds of countless economics students.
sentences.translation: 该图表在无数经济学学生的头脑中牢牢地灌输了一种危险的偏见。

sentences.sentence: To rise thither with my inebriate Soul!
sentences.translation: 带着我的酒醉的灵魂向那里飞腾！

sentences.sentence: That evening, The boy drank much wine but he didn't inebriate, therefore didn't become careless.
sentences.translation: 那天晚上，男孩饮了许多酒但他没有醉，并没有因此而变得糊涂。

sentences.sentence: Some tiny inebriate, he like a baby last smiled and rattled on about the past, also stand up by waving his hands.
sentences.translation: 有些微醉的时候，他像个孩子一样地笑着，喋喋不休地说起过去，还站起来挥舞双手。

translations.translation: 规避, 逃避, 躲避

sentences.sentence: You can’t go on evading your responsibilities in this way.
sentences.translation: 你不能这样继续逃避责任。

sentences.sentence: You’re simply trying to evade the problem.
sentences.translation: 你根本是在设法逃避问题。

sentences.sentence: Laws stipulate the maximum interest rate that banks can charge.
sentences.translation: 法律对银行可以收取的最高利率作了规定。

translations.translation: 骇人听闻的, 可怕的

sentences.sentence: Every article on the breakfast table was fetched away with a hideous crash.
sentences.translation: 早餐桌上的每件物品随着可怕的撞击声移动了位置。

sentences.sentence: People might think you have a hideous bowel disease or perhaps a fiber fetish.
sentences.translation: 人们可能会认为你有一个可怕的肠道疾病或者纤维恋物癖。

sentences.sentence: Don't be afraid to ask someone that same question whose color you think is hideous, so you know where not to go.
sentences.translation: 不要害怕问同一个问题关于一些人谁的颜色你认为可怕，因此你才知道什么地方不应该去做。

text:
英语词汇 · GRE · 第 307 单元

transmute
音标：英 /trænz'mjuːt; trɑːnz-; -ns-/  美 /trænz'mjut/
v. 改变
例句：Ascension long ago served to transmute karma of the consensus known as Earth so that Earth could retain her vibration.
很久之前，提升就为改变地球这个一致实相的业力而服务，好让地球可留在其振动中。
例句：That luxury appears to be fading as power consumption has skyrocketed and the circuit boards on which the microprocessors sit threaten to transmute themselves into space heaters.
但随著耗电量急遽高升，微处理器所在的电路板恐有变身为暖炉的危险，电脑产业既有的优势似乎正渐渐消逝。

quail
音标：英 /kweɪl/  美 /kwel/
v. 感到恐惧
短语：quail egg — 鹌鹑蛋

taint
音标：英 /teɪnt/  美 /tent/
v. 感染
例句：When performing taint flow analysis, the scanner models the flow of data within the system.
当执行污染流分析时，检测器会在这个系统中为数据流建立模型。

induct
音标：英 /ɪn'dʌkt/  美 /ɪn'dʌkt/
v. 感应

lacerate
音标：英 /'læsəreɪt/  美 /'læsəret/
v. 割裂
例句：His fingers were badly lacerated by the broken glass.
他的手指被碎玻璃严重割伤。

segregate
音标：英 /'segrɪgeɪt/  美 /'sɛɡrɪɡet/
v. 隔离
例句：A large detachment of police was used to segregate the two rival camps of protesters.
一大队分遣警察被派来隔离两群敌对的抗议者。

seclude
音标：英 /sɪ'kluːd/  美 /sɪ'klud/
v. 隔离
例句：In the early 1990’s an extreme form of isolation emerged, where young Japanese people seclude themselves in their homes for months or even years at a time.
早在20世纪90年代初的时候，日本出现了一种极端的孤独症状，患有此症状的日本青年人一度成年累月地把自己隔离在家中。

eradicate
音标：英 /ɪ'rædɪkeɪt/  美 /ɪ'rædɪket/
v. 根除
例句：an attempt to eradicate inflation
为消除通货膨胀所作的努力
例句：This problem has now been completely eradicated.
这个问题现已彻底杜绝。

consolidate
音标：英 /kən'sɒlɪdeɪt/  美 /kən'sɑlɪdet/
v. 巩固
例句：The company has consolidated its position as the country’s leading gas supplier.
这家公司巩固了作为该国主要煤气供应商的地位。
例句：The team consolidated their lead with a third goal.
球队以第三个进球巩固了领先优势。

conspire
音标：英 /kən'spaɪə/  美 /kən'spaɪɚ/
v. 共谋, 阴谋, (指事件)凑合起来
例句：They'd conspired to overthrow the government.
他们曾合谋推翻政府。

purvey
音标：英 /pə'veɪ/  美 /pə'vei/
v. 供给, 供应
例句：DJ Dominic purveys a unique brand of music.
音乐节目主持人多米尼克播放一种独特的音乐。

preach
音标：英 /priːtʃ/  美 /pritʃ/
v. 鼓吹
例句：Alexander has been preaching patience.
亚历山大一直宣扬要坚忍。

instigate
音标：英 /'ɪnstɪgeɪt/  美 /'ɪnstə'get/
v. 鼓动
例句：He accused union leaders of instigating the disturbances.
他指责工会领导人煽动骚乱。

invigorate
音标：英 /ɪn'vɪgəreɪt/  美 /ɪn'vɪɡəret/
v. 鼓舞
例句：Carey’s hope was that the church would be renewed and invigorated.
凯里希望教会能复兴。

indoctrinate
音标：英 /ɪn'dɒktrɪneɪt/  美 /ɪn'dɑktrɪnet/
v. 灌输
例句：People were indoctrinated not to question their leaders.
人们被灌输对领导人不得置疑的观念。

implant
音标：英 /ɪm'plɑːnt/  美 /ɪm'plænt/
v. 灌输
短语：dental implant — 牙移植
短语：cochlear implant — 人工耳蜗；耳蜗植入；耳郭灌输治疗
例句：The diagram implanted a dangerous prejudice firmly in the minds of countless economics students.
该图表在无数经济学学生的头脑中牢牢地灌输了一种危险的偏见。

inebriate
音标：英 /ɪ'niːbrɪeɪt/  美 /i'ni:briət/
v. 灌醉
例句：To rise thither with my inebriate Soul!
带着我的酒醉的灵魂向那里飞腾！
例句：That evening, The boy drank much wine but he didn't inebriate, therefore didn't become careless.
那天晚上，男孩饮了许多酒但他没有醉，并没有因此而变得糊涂。
例句：Some tiny inebriate, he like a baby last smiled and rattled on about the past, also stand up by waving his hands.
有些微醉的时候，他像个孩子一样地笑着，喋喋不休地说起过去，还站起来挥舞双手。

evade
音标：英 /ɪ'veɪd/  美 /ɪ'ved/
v. 规避, 逃避, 躲避
短语：evade tax — 逃税
例句：You can’t go on evading your responsibilities in this way.
你不能这样继续逃避责任。
例句：You’re simply trying to evade the problem.
你根本是在设法逃避问题。

stipulate
音标：英 /'stɪpjʊleɪt/  美 /'stɪpjulet/
v. 规定, 保证
短语：stipulate for — v. 制订；规定
例句：Laws stipulate the maximum interest rate that banks can charge.
法律对银行可以收取的最高利率作了规定。

hideous
音标：英 /'hɪdɪəs/  美 /'hidiəs/
v. 骇人听闻的, 可怕的
例句：Every article on the breakfast table was fetched away with a hideous crash.
早餐桌上的每件物品随着可怕的撞击声移动了位置。
例句：People might think you have a hideous bowel disease or perhaps a fiber fetish.
人们可能会认为你有一个可怕的肠道疾病或者纤维恋物癖。
例句：Don't be afraid to ask someone that same question whose color you think is hideous, so you know where not to go.
不要害怕问同一个问题关于一些人谁的颜色你认为可怕，因此你才知道什么地方不应该去做。
